page.layout: One column of text, full width. Running head and page number at the top. Below them: running text, a centred heading (EPIST. XI.), an argument summary, an italic address and salutation, and the opening paragraph with a woodcut initial. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: se. Baal Naturim subtilius philosophatur, ut scilicet doceatur, solem tunc ad illuminandum datum esse: sed codex Samaritanus perfecte scribit מאורות mysteriaq; omnia ista in ventos diffundit. Plurima sunt magni momenti, in quibus codex ille ab Hebræo differt, & cum LXX. consentit, sed de his alias. Vale vir clariss. & quod mihi exoptatissimum est, me amare perge.
main_text.head: EPIST. XI.
main_text.p: Aubertus Miræus Jo. Morino gratias agit de Libro Exertitationum Eccle-siasticarum, quo eum donaverat Morinus.

p.i: Reverendo admodum Patri J. Morino Aub. Miræus, S. D.

main_text.p: EXercitationum Ecclesiasticarum Li-bros duos eruditionis variæ plenos antea mihi non visos, ut primum accepi, avide mox percurri; gratiam habeo pro munere, & hortor, ut tertium, qvartum

page.notes: No marginal notes. The woodcut initial E is joined to "Xercitationum". The catchword "&" at the lower right is the start of the next page. The Hebrew word מאורות is copied from the scan. The printed spelling "Exertitationum" in the argument differs from "Exercitationum" in the body; both are kept as printed. Stains and show-through at the right edge are left out.
